paragraphs.text: The Osai Desert is a vast and desolate desert region found on the plane of Shandalar , situated in close proximity to the ancient city of Ardestan . This arid expanse is notorious for its scorching heat, relentless dry winds, and the harsh, unforgiving terrain that stretches for miles in all directions.

One of the most distinctive features of the Osai Desert is its flocks of hardy scavengers known as Osai Vultures . These resilient birds thrive in the desert 's barren wastes, feeding on the remains of any creature unfortunate enough to perish beneath the blazing sun. Remarkably, the Osai Vultures are not confined to Shandalar alone. When a planar portal was opened in the desert at some point, these hardy birds managed to cross between planes, appearing far from their native sands in the Sukurvian Desert of Jamuraa on the plane of Dominaria . This portal was closed in the Great Mending , if not before, although the later presence of Omenpaths across the Multiverse may have created new connections to Shandalar.
